The Term That Stands in for a Term During a Pilot Fit

Source: R/variants.R
term_pilot.Rd

Returns the unbuilt term with which a fitting layer replaces term in a pilot fit, or NULL when the term needs no pilot. A term returns one when it carries a discrete choice that the data must settle (the index of the mode of shape_unimodal(), or, with the mode given, which of two starts to keep), which the layer makes with term_variants() from the contribution that the stand-in fits.

Usage

term_pilot(term, ...)

Arguments

term

A term, built or not.

...

Passed to methods.

Value

NULL, or an unbuilt term carrying the label of term.

See also

term_variants(), which reads the pilot.

Examples

term_pilot(s(x))
#> NULL
class(term_pilot(scs(x, shape_unimodal())))[1]
#> [1] "modelterms7::SmoothTerm"

# A monotone shape carries no choice and needs no pilot.
term_pilot(scs(x, shape_increasing()))
#> NULL
